metadata.title: Controlled Recommendation Rule-Consistency Evaluation
metadata.scientific_disclaimer: Controlled algorithmic benchmark evaluating recommendation selection invariants, ranking consistency, and rule adherence. This benchmark measures SOFTWARE CORRECTNESS and ALGORITHMIC VALIDITY under controlled simulated states; it does NOT measure human learning gains, pedagogical effectiveness, or retention.

scenarios.name: High-Confidence Weakness Triggers Remediation
scenarios.description: Student has an established weakness (S=0.20, C=0.85) on Convolution. Recommender must rank it Top-1 with LOW_KNOWLEDGE and active remediation action.

scenarios.name: Low-Confidence Uncertainty Distinguished from Deficit
scenarios.description: Student has nascent confidence (C=0.15, S=0.45) on Nyquist Rate with zero assessments. Recommender must assign LOW_CONFIDENCE and must NOT assign LOW_KNOWLEDGE.

scenarios.name: Unmastered Prerequisite Halts Downstream Topic
scenarios.description: Student attempts Convolution while prerequisite LTI System has deficit. Convolution must recommend REVIEW_PREREQUISITE with PREREQUISITE_DEFICIT reason code.

scenarios.name: Downstream Blocker Receives Priority Boost
scenarios.description: LTI System blocks downstream concepts (Convolution) and must receive higher downstream_blocker_score than an isolated leaf concept.

scenarios.name: Study Without Assessment Triggers Assessment Gap Flag
scenarios.description: Student has completed reading on Sampling Theorem (C=0.40) but zero assessments. Recommender must flag ASSESSMENT_GAP and provide grounded action.

scenarios.name: Recent Action Damping Prevents Monopolization
scenarios.description: Two equally weak concepts: Concept A was acted upon 2 minutes ago. Concept B must achieve higher priority due to recency penalty on A.

scenarios.name: Mastered Concept Deprioritized Below Unresolved Needs
scenarios.description: Student has achieved S=0.95, C=0.92 on Linearity. Linearity priority must be damped below active unmastered learning concepts.

scenarios.name: Cold Start Recommends Grounded Foundations Safely
scenarios.description: Student with zero history receives recommendations without crash; top items feature UNCERTAIN or LOW_CONFIDENCE.

scenarios.name: Strict Student Isolation Under Concurrent Queries
scenarios.description: State updates and recommendations for Student A do not cross-contaminate or alter recommendations for Student B.

scenarios.name: Deterministic Output Across Identical Invocations
scenarios.description: Consecutive calls on the exact same student state yield byte-identical recommendation priorities, actions, and orderings.
